title: Chicken Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole made with chicken, velvety sauce, and Canadian goodness, all gluten-free.
instructions: Cook the gluten-free pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the chicken breasts until cooked through.
Add the velvety sauce and Canadian casserole mix to the skillet, stirring until well combined.
In a separate bowl, combine the cooked pasta, chicken mixture, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
